dct_creator_sm: Kate Keenan, Parks Canada / Parcs Canada.
dct_description_sm:
To support effective stormwater management planning, municipalities require an understanding of the types and sources of stormwater contaminants within their community. End-of-pipe grab samples collected from four outfalls (C1- C4) and two background reference sites (B1 and B2) during 21 rainfall and snowmelt events from Oct 2020- April 2024. Samples were analysed for a suit of over 50 parameters including dissolved and total metals, nutrients and physio-chemical parameters. These data compliment the Screening-level Ecological Risk Assessment of Town of Banff Stormwater dataset which was used in the following: 
https://doi.org/10.1080/07011784.2026.2634745
dct_title_s: Town of Banff Stormwater Quality Monitoring
